title: 11 True Horror Stories Animated (Compilation of March 2025)

transcript.text: My name is Katarina, and I have a story that happened to me nine years ago.
My grandmother told me that when a person dies, they may give you a sign before they're
passing.
I didn't believe her because I thought it was just an old superstition with no scientific
evidence.
I have a sister, her name is Clementina.
She was the perfect sister for me, kind, sweet, and someone that I always got along with,
my best friend.
On April 18th, 2015, I was home alone.
Clementina was on a trip with her friends, while my parents were attending my cousin's
birthday party.
It was just a typical Saturday night.
I made some noodles and watched my favorite movie.
While watching, I felt sleepy since it was already late.
I immediately went to bed and fell asleep.
I was suddenly awakened by someone gently caressing my hair and singing my favorite lullaby, even
in the darkness of my room, I immediately recognized who it was.
It was Clementina.
I called her name and asked her what time she had come home, but she didn't respond.
I told her to go back to sleep, but she didn't listen.
She just kept singing my favorite lullaby while caressing my hair.
It was strange because she never really sang, and she continued and continued, and her voice
started to sound cold and eerie.
Suddenly, the temperature dropped in my room.
My body became stiff.
I couldn't even move a single finger.
I was frozen.
I hoped this was just a nightmare, but it was real, and I didn't know what to do.
Paralized with fear, I couldn't push her away or run.
A few moments later, she finally stopped and said these words.
I'll miss you in heaven, caerina.
Her voice was chilling.
After sang those words, she stood up and left my bed.
I sighed in relief.
Was she drunk, sleepwalking?
I didn't know why she acted this way.
When I woke up in the morning, I found my parents crying in the living room.
Confused, I asked them what was wrong.
What my mother said gave me goose bumps.
Your sister passed away last night in a car accident.
My mother sobbed.
I stood there, frozen.
I couldn't believe what she was saying.
A wave of shock and grief washed over me.
Then, I remembered what had happened the night before.
I thought about the superstition my grandmother had told me.
I also remembered what Clementina had said before leaving.
I'll miss you in heaven.
Had my sister given me a sign about her death?
How did I not realize it?
My mind filled with questions, but the one thing I couldn't accept
was that she was truly gone.
Ten years have passed since that night.
While writing this, I still can't help but feel sad about my sister.
I still struggle to accept that she said goodbye to us at such a young age.
But one question still lingers in my mind.
Was she giving me a sign?
Why did she seem so eerie?
Why did she sound so creepy?
Maybe it was just my imagination playing tricks on me.
Or maybe it wasn't.
Hello, onesie.
I always watch your videos and I'm shocked by all the stories.
But I never thought I would experience one myself or that my girlfriend would.
This happened to my girlfriend and her friends.
We live in the state of Rodonia, Brazil.
It was a Sunday morning and I was at church.
My girlfriend had spent the night at her friend's house
and they were on their way to meet me.
For the first time, they decided to take a different route.
But what they saw on the way is something they will never forget.
They witnessed three men dragging a homeless man.
He was covered in blood, head to toe,
and they were forcing him toward a pickup truck.
My girlfriend, who was in the front seat,
rolled down her window and shouted for them to stop.
The men all turned around and looked at her and tried to explain
that the homeless man had stolen from a woman.
But there was no woman around and nothing was scattered on the ground.
There was no sign that he had stolen anything at all.
As they were about to leave, another man arrived, holding a machete.
And then, he started to walk towards the homeless man
and slowly began stabbing him over and over again.
Her friend, who was driving, panicked and sped away.
They immediately called the police who asked for the exact location.
Since they weren't sure, they decided to go back to find the place
and get the pickup truck's license plate number.
When they got closer, they only saw the truck speeding away
and the homeless man still lying on the ground but alive.
They were about to approach him when a man on a motorcycle pulled up next to their car.
And once again, tried to explain that the homeless man had stolen from someone.
Feeling helpless, they gave up and joined me at church.
Later on, some other people from the church went to the scene
and saw that same homeless man sitting there
with a few people around him helping.
When my girlfriend told me what happened, I couldn't stop thinking.
What if they hadn't taken that rent?
What if they hadn't shouted for the man to stop?
Where were that homeless man being now?
I believe they were used by God to save his life.
When I was in college, I used to wake up really early.
Around 3 a.m., to study because I thought it helped me understand better
and it was nice and quiet.
On this particular day, we had an exam at school
so I was tired and hungry when I got home around 9 p.m.
My plan was to sleep early and wake up later to study for another exam the next day.
I felt upset because there was very little food left for me that night in the fridge.
Instead of having a meal, I spent time scrolling through my phone.
The battery was running low and I didn't notice how much time it passed.
Suddenly, it was 11 p.m., and I had to decide whether to charge my phone
or use it as an alarm.
I didn't have an alarm clock by my bed and the charging outlet was in the living room.
If I charged it in there, I was afraid I wouldn't hear the alarm.
So I decided to set it for 2 a.m.
to make sure the battery wouldn't die and the alarm would still work.
When the alarm went off at 2 a.m., I noticed that my bedroom door was wide open.
At first, I thought my mom had checked on me while I slept as she often did
and had forgotten to close the door.
But that felt strange.
She had never forgotten before.
If she had, it would have annoyed me a little bit and I would have noticed.
I laid there for a minute, staring at the dark corner of my room.
The mosquito net above my bed made everything even darker
and I couldn't see the room clearly.
After a minute or two, I decided to get up and pull back the net.
To my shock, someone or something emerged from behind the open door.
This person had been crouching there the whole time,
waiting for me to make a move.
Frozen in fear, I screamed as I tried to run out of the room.
To my horror, we both lunged for the door at the exact same time
and I found myself face to face with a man I didn't recognize at all.
He raised his index finger to his lips, signaling for me to be quiet.
Then, he ran out of my room into the kitchen and out the front door of my house.
I pounded on my mom's bedroom door, yelling and screaming.
When she opened it, I was terrified and I told her there was a man in my room.
I cried and begged her not to go outside because I was afraid he might still be in the area.
We screamed for help from inside, hoping our neighbors would hear us.
Fortunately, one of our neighbors happened to be coming home and rushed over.
He woke up the others and asked for assistance.
When we checked the house later, we thought it might have been a robbery
because my school bag was on the kitchen table, its contents scattered everywhere.
But I couldn't stop thinking about the terrifying possibilities because I distinctly remember
placing my school bag in my bedroom. Why did he go back to my room?
I'm just thankful I set my alarm earlier than 3am and decided not to charge my phone.
Because if I had set it for 3am, what could have happened in that extra hour?
And if I had charged it, I wouldn't have woken up to the alarm and who knows what might have happened.
I guess I was just lucky that day.
We tried to find the person but he was never caught.
After I graduated, my family and I moved to a bigger city.
Be careful out there. You never know who's looking.
Hi, my name is Ovi and this story happened when I was around 12 years old.
My family lived far away from my extended relatives.
My grandparents, uncle, aunt and cousins.
So we only visited them twice a year.
My grandfather owned a large house at the end of a very long road lined with homes on either side.
A few houses away from ours right next to a park stood a massive abandoned mansion.
It was infamous in the neighborhood. People spoke about it in hushed tones.
Strange things always seem to happen there with no explanation.
Dead birds were often found inside and once a neighbor's cat was discovered lifeless within its walls.
But the creepiest part, the entire ground floor and front gate were covered in old faded cartoon
stickers. They were meant to look playful but over time they'd become eerie like the cartoon faces
were crying. One night, my cousins and I, being typical adrenaline-filled kids, decided we had to
check it out. We planned carefully, my two older cousins who were the same age would sneak in first.
Once they confirmed it was safe, they'd radio us on the walkie-talkie and then us younger ones would
follow. After dinner, the older cousins left first. About 10 minutes later, we heard their voices
crackle through the walkie-talkie. Come on, it's fine. No danger. Just get here fast.
Excited yet uneasy, we grabbed our torches, sneaked out while the adults were distracted and ran
to the house. Standing outside, looking at those unsettling stickers, we hesitated for a moment.
But then, from upstairs, we heard our cousins calling down to us.
Something felt off. Their voices sounded normal, but something deep in my gut told me not to go inside.
My younger cousins must have felt it, too, because we all hesitated.
Nope, we're not coming up. We're leaving. We shouted back.
You should leave, too. Then, without waiting for a response, we bolted back home.
But the moment we stepped inside, our stomach dropped. Sitting on the couch, happily eating ice cream,
were our older cousins. We froze. How did you guys get home before us?
We asked, with our voices shaking. They looked confused.
What are you talking about? We never went to the mansion.
One of them said, our blood ran cold. They explained that their mom had overheard our plan and warned
them not to go. Instead, she sent them out to buy ice cream to distract us. They hadn't even brought
their walkie-talkies with them. So then, who had called us on the walkie-talkie?
Who had we heard inside that mansion?
Terrified, we told our mothers everything. Their faces went pale. That's when they finally told
us the mansion's dark history. Years ago, a family of four had lived there. A man, his wife,
and his elderly parents. The wife used to run a small daycare, which is why the house was decorated
with cartoon stickers, to amuse the children. One day, the family decided to move to a bigger city
after the man got a better job offer. But on the way there, they were in a brutal accident and no one
survived. After that, the mansion was abandoned. The remaining relatives were still fighting over
its ownership, which left it in a state of decay. By now, we were trembling, and over the next week,
strange things started happening to us. My bicycle, one I had for years, suddenly lost its
brakes while I was riding downhill. I crashed hard, injuring my arm, leaving scars that I still have
to this day. My cousins had minor accidents, too. Cuts, bruises, strange falls. Even my grandmother
felt uneasy. Fearing something had attached itself to us, she took us to a priest. He gave us protective
threads to tie around our wrists and recited prayers over us. Thankfully, after that, nothing else
happened. The mansion is currently being renovated, but even now, whenever I pass it, I can't shake
the thought. What would have happened if we listened to that voice and gone upstairs?
My name is Ali, and I live in Sudan. I've been wanting to share this story for a long time.
I'm the second oldest of my siblings after my sister, who was 18. I'm 17 years old. My story
happened when I was 11 years old. We were a normal family. My mom was pregnant at that time.
After nine months of pregnancy, my mom gave birth to my new sister, and I rushed to the hospital
to see her. She was really cute. Unfortunately, my dad couldn't see her in person, but I did a video
call. He was working in another country. My dad cried with joy when he saw her. After my mom got
treatment, the neighbors were waiting for her to congratulate her and my mom's brother. My uncle was
staying with us. During the celebration party, this old lady suddenly approached my mom and congratulated
her. My mom was surprised at first, but said thank you without really thinking very much.
Later, all the family members ate dinner at night, and went to bed after about 10 pm,
but I woke up suddenly at 3 am because I wanted to use the bathroom. As I was walking to the bathroom,
I saw a silhouette of someone in my mom's room. I didn't think much of it because while I thought
maybe my uncle was checking on us, then as I was leaving the bathroom, I saw something shocking.
My uncle was throwing someone on the floor, punching them. He was yelling at me to go to my room and
not come out. A few minutes later, I heard police sirens. I could hear them in my uncle talking,
but I couldn't hear them very clearly. After the police left, my uncle told us to go back to sleep.
The next morning, I asked my uncle what had happened yesterday. He said something shocking.
He said that when he went to the kitchen to get some water, he saw a man kidnapping,
my newborn baby sister. My uncle got angry and quickly ran to the man, hitting him,
grabbing my sister. The man ran to my uncle and they fought. That's when I came out of the bathroom
and saw everything. A few hours later, the police knocked on my door. My uncle opened the door,
looked confused when he saw the policeman. When the officer said something, my uncle froze.
The officer told him that the man who had broken into our house had actually been paid
to kidnap my sister. My uncle was shocked, asked who had paid them. Then the officer told him,
it was that old lady who had come to congratulate my mother yesterday. Moreover, it was revealed that
she had kidnapped and sold four other newborns to anonymous people before my sister was born.
The old lady was, fortunately, arrested and she and the man were sentenced to life in prison.
But what would have happened if my uncle hadn't come out to drink water that night?
I thank God every day for protecting my newborn sister. I'm now 17 and my sister is six now.
We never told my father about what had happened that night.
One night, my mother was coming home from school on the bus. The bus wasn't full but it had
plenty of people already on it. One woman in particular got my mother's attention right away
because she started staring at my mother's belly. My mother was pregnant at the time but this woman
would not look away and she began getting closer and closer until it became extremely obvious that
this woman was up to something. Sensing something was off. The girl sitting next to my mother also felt
uneasy and asked if she wanted to switch seats. As time went by, the woman continued to stare at my mother's
belly. That triggered my mom to remember a superstition. If someone has no filtrum, there is a high
chance that they are not human. A filtrum is a vertical indentation in the middle area of the upper
lip. In our country, there is a creature called a whack whack. It is said to be a human during the day
but a monster at night capable of transforming into a bird. These creatures often appear during
festivals and offer people food but legend says you should never eat what they offer you.
My mom heard this story from her grandmother when she was very young and it was widely believed in
the area where they lived. Until my mother got off the bus, the woman continued staring at her and
after finally getting off, the woman followed her. My mom deliberately went the other way but the
woman followed close behind. My mother walked as fast as she could toward a crowded area and then quickly
darted out to try to find a ride. Luckily, a taxi was there and a man provided her a ride to get out
of the area. She finally got home and ran inside. My grandfather was waiting for her and as soon as he
saw her, he quickly wrapped his arms around her and picked her up. When my mom asked why, my grandfather
said he had seen a big bird and knew that the creature was in the area. Nothing dangerous happened in
the end but after that, my mom often heard knocking on the window at random parts throughout the day.
One day, my mom's friend who lived in the neighborhood came for a visit. She said she had seen a woman
outside her window, someone who looked strange and lacked a filter. My mom realized that the woman she
saw was exactly the same as the one that her friend had encountered.
I was 13 years old when this scary incident happened and I lived on the seventh floor of an apartment
building. I was coming home from school with my older brother, who was a year older than me.
And when we got to the building, we tried to take the elevator but it didn't work.
So my brother told me to take the stairs. So I agreed and he went up to the seventh floor faster than me.
When I got to the fourth floor, I heard the sound of someone walking in high heels below me.
I thought it was my neighbor who lived on the fourth floor and I wanted to say hello. So I waited
for her to come but all I could hear was the sound of high heels getting closer. So I just went back
upstairs. That night I went to sleep because I had to go to school the next day. Then I woke up in
the middle of the night, sweating all over my body. I wondered why but I thought it was just because it
was hot so I opened the window. I fell asleep again but woke up again in the middle of the night.
My whole body was drenched in sweat again. I was confused. I thought it was nothing, tried to go
back to sleep but I couldn't move. I was scared. I didn't want to open my eyes but I saw something
standing in the corner of the room and suddenly the shadow started jumping at me. I screamed
and tried to move and I realized that I was literally in sleep paralysis. I'd seen on YouTube that
moving your feet could help you get out of sleep paralysis. So I tried moving my feet and luckily
it worked. I was so scared that I ran to my parents room and woke my mom up. I cried.
Told her what had happened and she started praying for me. And when I woke up the next day,
I heard shocking news. My neighbor on the fourth floor had died for unknown reasons.
She was wearing red high heels and a red dress. It was like she was going to a party and her cat
was found dead in the bathroom. I was shocked. That night I woke up again in the middle of the night
and couldn't move and I saw something shocking right before my eyes. It was a woman in a red dress
with a cat. I realized she was my neighbor on the fourth floor who had died the day before
but her face was very pale and her cat was covered in blood. I closed my eyes and I started praying
when I woke up the next morning. Luckily there was nothing in my room. I didn't tell my parents.
I thought I was just hallucinating but I really have so many questions. Why did this happen to me?
Why did she come to my room?
Hey, I'm a really big fan of your channel and I wanted to share a story my dad told me when I was
younger. When my dad was around 16 years old he was working on a ranch in Idaho. His job was
to wrangle the horses that always ran off deep into the mountains. He would always use his own horse
angel to go and catch them. My dad said angel was a funny horse because she always acted like a dog
very playful and full of energy. Every so often when the horses ran off even deeper than normal
my dad would pass by an old abandoned shack that looked like it had been falling apart for years.
Every time he passed it the hair on the back of his neck would stand up and he'd get an eerie
feeling but it wasn't just him. Angel, his normally playful horse, would start bucking and snorting
at the side of the house that really freaked my dad out. One day while he wasn't town he ran into
another ranch worker who had been there for a few years. They started chatting over lunch and since
the guy knew the area so well my dad asked, what's the deal with the creepy run down house?
As soon as he said that the man's friendly smile changed into something else, a strange unsettling
grin. You really want to know kid? The man asked? My dad said yes and so the man told him this story.
Back in the mid 1900s a man named Frederick Beale lived in that house. Everyone just called him Beale.
He didn't want to live near civilization so he built the house in the mountains with his own two
hands and lived there for many years. Each summer Beale would come down into town where the locals
always expected him. He'd stock up on supplies before heading back into the mountains. He wasn't a
mean old man. Actually he was quite friendly so the townspeople always looked forward to his visits.
During the summer he lived off the food he bought in town. In the winter when heavy snow made
the trip impossible he hunted animals to survive. But then one year the townspeople noticed something
strange. Beale never came down for his usual summer visit. Days passed and then weeks and finally
months and people started to worry. After a while the sheriff and a few deputies rode out on horseback
to go and check on him. As they neared the house they immediately knew something was wrong. The forest
was too quiet, unnaturally quiet. When they arrived they saw that everything was boarded up
in a foul stench hung in the air. After forcing the door open they stepped into the living room
and what they found made their stomachs drop to the floor. Beale's rotting corpse lay on the ground
a single bullet hole in his head. A gun still held in his hand. It was obvious he had taken his own life
but why? The officers searched the house for clues and eventually found a crumpled up note in his
coat pocket. The handwriting was messy and uneven but they were able to read it after looking closer.
The note read, help me god! I've gone blind! The town was shocked the old man had lost his
eyesight with no way to make it back to town and no way to hunt. He must have realized there was no
hope or he didn't have any. Rather than starving to death he made a choice. After hearing that story
my dad swore that every time he passed by that house it felt like someone was watching him.
This is not my story but my grandfather's. This incident happened in Tijuana, Mexico in the late 70s
when my grandfather was in his late teens. One evening he decided to go to the movies alone.
He arrived at the theater, bought his ticket and sat down in the theater while he was watching the
movie. For some reason he decided to look around. That's when he noticed this woman sitting nearby.
They looked at each other for a moment and the woman walked over and sat down next to my grandfather.
They started holding hands and then drawn by the strange atmosphere. They started kissing.
Meanwhile he noticed that she was unnaturally cold. He gave her his jacket as a friendly gesture
and soon the movie was over. They were planning to walk across the street to a bar but she said that
she needed to use the bathroom. She told him just wait outside the bathroom. She gave him his
jacket back and gave him a ring saying that she was actually homeless. My grandfather was a little
taken aback but he didn't think much of it and decided to wait outside the bathroom as she had said.
But five minutes passed and she still hadn't come out of the bathroom. My grandfather watched all the
other women come out of the bathroom except for that woman and after ten minutes she still hadn't come
out. He went to the manager asked if he had seen anyone like that woman in the bathroom.
The manager told my grandfather that he had never seen anyone like that. My grandfather insisted
that the manager go and check. When the manager checked the woman was not in the bathroom.
My grandfather was about to give up looking for her but then he remembered that during a conversation
with the woman earlier she'd mentioned that she worked at the bar that they were going to go to.
So my grandfather decided to leave the theater, walked to the bar, smoked a cigarette and looked
around. He met the bartender, asked him about the woman and the bartender said that he didn't know
any women like that working there and that he would ask the owner. After a few minutes the owner
approaches my grandfather, asks again who was he looking for? My grandfather described the woman again
and suddenly the owner's face changed. His expression became solemn and he looked at my grandfather
as if he were crazy. Then my grandfather showed him the ring that she had given him in the theater
and the owner looked shocked. Told my grandfather that it couldn't be true.
My grandfather asked what he meant by that and the owner told him the woman had been murdered about a
year ago. My grandfather was shocked, left the bar and went home. This incident stuck in his memory.
He still thinks about it sometimes. Sometimes he doubts the situation, tells himself that the owner just
thought of the wrong woman but then he remembers the ring he showed the owner couldn't be another woman.
He doesn't know if it was a spirit of some kind, a doppelganger, but all he knows is that the girl he
met that night was not a normal human being. Also, the fact that she was unusually cold
still makes him uneasy. He still thinks about what happened that night.
Hi, I'm Diana and I live in the United States. This happened in Massachusetts and is one of the
reasons I became a horror junkie because the paranormal seemed to follow me throughout my childhood.
Everything I'm about to say is the truth exactly as I remember it. Most of my childhood is a blur
but this memory has never faded. I think we all struggle to recall much of when we were babies.
It feels like an extended period of nothingness but for me there's one thing I remember with absolute
clarity. When I was a baby up until I was two my family lived in the basement of a stranger's house.
We had almost nothing just a mattress on the floor, two cabinets and a few pieces of sparse furniture
in a small dusty room. My parents were immigrants and we were just getting by. The details of that
space are hazy now but what happened at night is something I'll never forget. Every evening my loving
protective parents would tuck my sister and I onto the mattress while they took the floor.
The lights would go out and one by one we would fall asleep but in the middle of the night
I would wake up and every time I saw them big white hands like those of a mime reaching out from
beneath the cabinet. The hands moved with deliberate motions drawing shapes in the air waving
beckoning. I remember staring transfixed. Sometimes I would reach out trying to touch them
but before I could my mother would stir pull me back and allow me to sleep. This happened over and
over. I remember those hands so vividly they looked normal but they weren't and what disturbed me
the most was that I never saw who or what they were attached to. When I was two we moved into a real
home leaving that basement for good and somehow the memories of the hands faded buried under the
warmth of a new life until I turned 14 years old. That day my older sister and I were reminiscing about
our childhood laughing about our old home until she asked me did you ever see those hands? I froze my
stomach dropped. What hands? I asked my voice barely above a whisper she hesitated before continuing.
The hands that came from under the cabinet at night the white ones they would reach for us.
My heart pounded I felt like I couldn't breathe. How did she see them too? I had spent years convincing
myself they weren't real that they were just the overactive imagination of a child but she saw them
as well. We sat there shaken trading details how they moved how they looked how we never saw a body
attached to them. Was that basement haunted? Were those hands trying to take us? Later I did some
research and I found something chilling. Many people have reported seeing similar hands during childhood
but not white ones. There's were green or black.
This is a scary incident that happened to me when I was a college student. I remember it was the day after
Halloween I was a freshman. You'll soon find out why I remember this. I remember waking up late in
the morning having to get up quickly to get to campus for my chemistry lab. My roommate was probably
disturbed as I kept making noise and rushing to head out. Since snow buses would come at this time
I had no choice but to walk all the way to campus which is like a 10 to 15 minute walk from my dorm.
As I was walking on the street it was quiet and weren't that many students around especially after
a Halloween weekend I'm not surprised. As I made my way uphill I suddenly saw a large tall man
wearing what looked to be a scream ghost face costume staring at an old homeless man that
seemed to be curled up with his blanket on a bench. I was taken aback since Halloween was over now
and now that classes have resumed it's a bit odd seeing this man dressed up at such early time in
the morning. At first I didn't know what to make of it knowing I had to hurry to my lab to be allowed
inside so I didn't pay much attention. However, something felt off as I passed by this guy with the
scream ghost face costume kept staring at me as I made my way closer to campus. I kept looking back
and he kept standing next to the homeless man staring at me. That time felt very long. I felt uneasy
that if I kept looking at him he would come towards me so I thought I should hurry to the lab.
However after walking a little I suddenly felt this chill down my spine and when I turned around
the homeless man and the ghost face man were gone. I was shocked. Could two people just disappear
in such a short amount of time? Panicking. I ran towards campus headed inside afraid of this incident.
What was even weirder is that after a couple of days later the homeless man that's always
sleeping on this bench never returned. A couple of students that I've talked to apparently said he was
taken by the police for disturbing the piece but I know that can't be true. Even so my excitement
towards Halloween has always been disturbed by this incident even to this day.
